title: Nuisance-probe diagnostics (R2 rejection rule)
statement: Held-out embedding probes need outer-train/outer-test cell embeddings from fitted R1, R2 and R3 fold models. No fitted ladder models exist, so no probe was fit and the R2 rejection rule could not be applied.

evidence.saved_models: no *.pt or *.pth file anywhere in the worktree

plan_section_4_2_rule: R2 rejected if nuisance-probe accuracy drop < 5 points vs R1 OR donor BA drops > 0.05 vs R1.
